name: PM SETU (Pradhan Mantri Skilling and Employability Transformation through Upgraded ITIs) – Component II: Capacity Augmentation of Five National Skill Training Institutes (NSTIs) and Setting up of Five National Centres of Excellence for Skilling
benefit:
1. Infrastructure Upgradation of 5 NSTIs at Bhubaneswar, Chennai, Hyderabad, Kanpur, and Ludhiana — Estimated Total Cost ₹1,00,00,00,00,000 (₹1,000 crore), i.e., ₹2,00,00,00,000 (₹200 crore per NSTI), including civil infrastructure, equipment, and support facilities.
1. Operational and Workforce Cost — ₹1,00,00,00,000 (₹100 crore) total (₹20,00,00,000 / ₹20 crore per NSTI).

_eligibility_text: > **A. For Lead Industry Partner (LIP) / Consortium:** 1. The applicant should be an industry partner applying individually or as the lead member of a consortium. 1. The applicant should have a minimum annual turnover of ₹5,00,00,00,000 (₹500 crore). 1. The applicant should have a minimum employee strength of 500. 1. The applicant should commit a minimum industry contribution of ₹40,00,00,000 (₹40 crore) per NSTI over a five-year period. 1. In the case of a consortium, the prescribed minimum requirements of annual turnover and employee strength shall be fulfilled exclusively by the Lead Industry Partner. 1. The Chairperson nominated by the LIP must be an active employee of the LIP and should be at a senior leadership level. > **B. For Trainees / Students of Upgraded NSTI Programmes:** 1. The applicant should be a Class 10 pass-out and above. 1. The applicant may be a working professional, graduate, or postgraduate seeking higher-level skilling programmes. > **Course-Specific Eligibility (Annexure III):** 1. CTS (National Trade Certificate): The applicant should have passed Class 8th, 10th, or 12th, depending on the trade. 1. CITS (National Craft Instructor Certificate): The applicant should have completed CTS (ITI), NAC (National Apprenticeship Certificate), Diploma, or Degree. 1. Short-term Courses on Advanced Skilling: Eligibility depends on industry requirements. 1. Diploma: The applicant should have passed Class 10th or equivalent. 1. Advanced Diploma (Technical and Work-based): The applicant should have passed Class 12th or equivalent. 1. PG Certificate: The applicant should be a Graduate or Post-Graduate. > **Reservation / Inclusion:** 1. The Governing Body of each IMC shall include at least one female member to ensure diversity and inclusivity. 1. The Strategic Investment Plan (SIP) shall include specific activities related to inclusion and accessibility, enhancing participation of women, SC, ST, and PwD (Persons with Disabilities). 1. Female enrolment target: 30% of enrolled students by end of 5th year.
